name: Skill Development Report
query:
SELECT 
    employee_id AS "Emp ID",
    full_name AS "Employee Name",
    designation,
    department,
    division,
    sec_c_skill_1 AS "Skill 1",
    sec_c_skill_2 AS "Skill 2",
    sec_c_skill_3 AS "Skill 3",
    emp_sec_c_other AS "Other Skill"
FROM 
    `tabPerformance Appraisal`;
